title: RAS 2026 link.csv row
description: Schema for one row of link.csv. Each CSV row, parsed with appropriate column types, must validate against this schema. See spec v1.5 §3.2.

length.description: Physical length of the segment. Used in transport-cost calculation and shortest-path distance.

capacity.description: Link throughput capacity (C5). Mainline links are calibrated at 700,000; connector links at 10,000.

railroad_id.description: Owning railroad. -1 for shared / connector links.

free_speed.description: Reference operating speed. Not used in the v1.5 objective; reserved for future scheduling extensions.

tracks.description: Number of parallel main tracks on this segment (informational). Capacity already reflects multi-track effects.

geometry.description: WKT LINESTRING lon/lat polyline geometry for visualization. Optional for solver input.
